ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher per NS-7; do not apply any driver-account action on this case.

rejected_claims.reason: The driver's 'I was on my way when the rider cancelled' does not assert a rider no-show and, in any event, system records show the driver was ~2.7 km from the pickup heading away, and no driver cancellation occurred — so no NS-1/NS-2 basis to keep the fee exists.
